notes.title: Quadrata v2.0 Major Update!
notes.notes:
Level Editor

 Due to popular demand, a level editor has been added so players can design their own levels.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3676950/
 To ensure its price isn't added to the cost of the base game, it will be released as a separate DLC from the main game. But don't worry! The level editor will be very affordable. Plus, you can get a 20% discount on it thanks to the Quadrata Complete Bundle!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/52500/Quadrata_Complete_Bundle/
 If you encounter any bugs in the level editor, please report them to us. We want to provide you with a bug-free level editor.

Visual Updates

 The old, boring art style is finally gone! We've completely renewed the game's entire art style, staying true to a clean and minimalist design.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42582879/473d482150d6b44a7a6e692a854834a7da9c8226.gif
 The level opening and closing animations have been remake to match the game's new art style.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42582879/f77f0b1298cfd73744530dbac1a36fbce05bde1d.gif
 A setting that lets you choose from different grid designs has been added to the in-game menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42582879/3a82da87a760b00a36a2fc88cde3751caed73696.gif
 The unnecessary main menu and level selection screen have been removed.
 The game icon has been redesigned.
 The Mindlabor logo has been added to the start of the game.
 Display support has been added for non-16:9 resolutions.

Accessibility Updates

 The repetitive animations that made you wait when resetting a level no longer play, and level resets are now instant.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42582879/db44807abebb4f779a9c61399244f20def26d638.gif
 To help you undo any mistaken moves, an undo feature with unlimited uses has now been added.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42582879/779d3caeada1f98e71783ed472706a0a9aed2037.gif
 Gamepad support that works with all types of gamepads has been added.
 Dynamic in-game button prompts based on the input device being used have been added.
 A system for procedural music generation has been created so you don't always listen to the same music.
 Sound and music options have been separated, and you can now control both of them from the in-game menu.
 The game is now significantly more optimized and runs much better than before.

Steam Updates

 Quadrata is now Steam Deck Verified and also fully compatible with SteamOS.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42582879/3d054818c054af2649e0c1346b1ef0ae60a9e02e.png
 15 new achievements have been added, and they are now also included in the in-game menu so you can easily track your progress. Also, the old achievement has been removed. But don't worry, we have published a guide on how to quickly earn all the achievements in the game.
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3488853988 The visuals on the Steam page have been redesigned.
 The descriptions on the Steam page have been translated into a total of 29 languages.
 Due to the new content added to the game, a small adjustment has been made to its price. The game's price has been increased from $1.99 to $2.99. But don't worry! You'll be seeing higher discount percentages going forward.
 If you want to play the old version of the game, in your Steam Library, right-click on Quadrata and select "Properties..." from the bottom of the pop-up menu. In the window that opens, go to the "Betas" tab on the left, then choose the beta named "legacy" from the list. Steam will then update the game to this version.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42582879/3292be839834604ced74a73f07290e2404859190.gif

Cerebral Puzzle Showcase 2025
We will participate in the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase 2025, which will take place between May 29th and June 5th, with our games Quadrata and Lovux. Be sure to check out the other great puzzle games at the event.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42582879/13a56ca0177802f6cfc503798e20f6312aa1cfb6.png

To celebrate the major update, Quadrata and Lovux will be 50% off for the next week.

We also want to announce in advance that we will be releasing a major update for Lovux soon.

Don't forget to leave a review for Quadrata and Quadrata Level Editor on Steam!

Thanks to your support, we will continue making new puzzles!

With love,
Mindlabor

notes.title: Achievement Bug Fix
notes.notes:
I noticed this bug thanks to players who said that they couldn't get achievements after completing Quadrata.

Even though it was a little late, I fixed the problem. If you finished the game and didn't get the achievement, you need to pass the level 90 again for get the achievement.

You can quickly pass the level 90 with this combination "→ ↓ ← ↑ → ↓"

notes.title: Quadrata Small Update
notes.notes:
It's not a big update. We just fixed some bugs and added small new things.

What did we do?

New save system! Your previous save may have been deleted :(
Fixed the problem of not getting achievement on Mac
Now you can play the game with the mouse!
With Steam Cloud, you can continue the game from where you left off on your different devices!
There's also a cool main menu animation 💥🙌😱📢🎉📣🚨❗
